about.heading: The Architecture of a PM
about.subheading: Deconstructing systems, whether legal, narrative, or algorithmic.
about.originText: I started in law, dissecting complex regulatory logic. As a professional content writer and troupe member, I mastered narrative flow. Today, I combine these disciplines. Product management is just applied logic and clear communication—bridging the gap between raw engineering and human experience.
about.focusText: Currently building multi-agent AI systems, utilizing the Cursor IDE to accelerate development. My approach is heavily influenced by development economics and minimalist design—creating highly scalable, high-impact products like SubSentry and PaperLoop without the visual clutter.
bio: I'm a product manager with a specialized focus on Agentic AI. My background spans both technical execution and user-centric design.
I build tools that emphasize fluid interactions and real-time processing, ensuring complex AI workflows feel intuitive to the end user.
